column1: # Purpose: select Stow packages and the login Shells that receive them.
# Format: package<TAB>shell, with exactly two non-empty fields and one literal TAB.
# package: a unique directory under dotfiles/, using only letters, digits, _ or -.
# shell: all, bash, zsh or fish; matched against the basename of the login SHELL.
# Order: packages are deployed in file order, after Git dependencies are reconciled.
# Blank lines and lines beginning with # are ignored. No inline comments or quoting.
# Do not put paths, credentials, spaces around fields or embedded TABs in a row.
# Add files under dotfiles/<package>/ using paths relative to HOME before adding a row.
# Example (replace <TAB> with one literal TAB): example<TAB>all
